approvedBaseline.policy: Retained WGI questions append after the unchanged baseline. Existing active sessions and review state migrate only when this exact signature-relevant prefix is preserved.

extractionMethod: Native selectable PDF text extracted with Xpdf pdftotext 4.00 using layout and UTF-8 modes.
reviewPolicy: This release requires a verified keep, duplicate-skip, or reject decision for each source item 1-450 only; the full 671-item extraction and audit remain available for later work. A keep requires two independent, direct answer references on different websites for both the source and related MCQ, four options, and a fact-specific Urdu translation and explanation.
